verification_scope: Six current official-domain pages were read for building/store identity, predominant use and published address or scope.
source_policy: Official pages support classification and address/scope evidence only. No title boundary, canonical parcel ID, exact geometry or distance value is asserted.

candidates.official_scope: 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ; named tower footprint only
candidates.fresh_evidence: The official 22 Bishopsgate site describes a 61-level, 1.275 million sq ft smart building designed for modern occupiers and publishes the 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ address.

candidates.official_scope: Battersea Power Station development; Power Station building and wider multi-phase neighbourhood must remain separately scoped
candidates.fresh_evidence: The official masterplan identifies a 42-acre mixed-use neighbourhood of homes, shops, cafes, offices and public space; the restored Power Station itself includes apartments, offices, visitor attractions and more than 100 brands.

candidates.official_scope: One New Change, New Change, London EC4M 9AF; named building footprint only
candidates.fresh_evidence: Landsec's official property page describes One New Change as an iconic building combining shops, restaurants, leisure activities and office space and publishes the New Change, London EC4M 9AF address.

candidates.official_scope: Selfridges London, Oxford Street; store building, rear car park and adjoining uses require separate review
candidates.fresh_evidence: The official Selfridges London page identifies the landmark destination as a store with shopping, services, food, events and an in-store cinema and provides store directions and Oxford Street access context.

candidates.official_scope: Harrods, 87–135 Brompton Road, Knightsbridge, London SW1X 7XL; main department-store footprint only
candidates.fresh_evidence: Official Harrods pages identify the Knightsbridge store, its retail departments and in-store services and publish the 87–135 Brompton Road, Knightsbridge, London SW1X 7XL address.

candidates.official_scope: 123 Victoria Street, London SW1E 6RA; named office building footprint only
candidates.fresh_evidence: Landsec's official property page presents 123 Victoria Street as workplace property with flexible workspace, meeting facilities and building amenities and publishes 123 Victoria Street, London SW1E 6RA.
